luiskr.com / experiments/star-field/engine/registry / SFRegistryRecord

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/registry.ts:49

One catalogued record inside a shard — field keys are short on purpose (the 14 MB index would double with long names): n display name/designation, m apparent magnitude, d heliocentric distance in light-years, s spectral class, c constellation/catalog name, h host star (exoplanets), t object type code (DSOs), r redshift, y2 discovery year (exoplanets), x/y/z heliocentric light-years, i registry id.
